**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block checkout when the Stripe key is absent**

When the frontend publishable key is absent but the backend Stripe secrets are configured, this resolved-null promise is still passed to `Elements` after `createPaymentIntent` has created a pending order and reserved ticket inventory. `CheckoutForm` then permanently disables its Pay button because `useStripe()` returns null, while the ticket-purchase button remains available in `SocialEventsPage`, so customers can consume availability without any way to complete payment or see a configuration error. Gate the checkout before creating the payment intent or render an actionable unavailable state instead of entering the payment step.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Give the activity regions distinct accessible names**

When activity exists, this summary container and the recent-activity container at line 232 are both exposed as regions named “Actividad de usuarios.” Screen-reader region navigation therefore presents two indistinguishable destinations even though the enclosed tables are separately named; label this region as the per-user summary and the other as recent activity.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Label each concurrent loading operation distinctly**

On the initial social-page render, QR generation and the suggestions/network queries can all be pending simultaneously, but the three progress bars at lines 451, 565, and 624 are all named “Cargando conexiones.” The indicator here is actually generating the contact QR, and reusing the same name makes the concurrent statuses indistinguishable to screen-reader users; give each operation a specific label.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Give the board region a distinct accessible name**

When the Kanban stages are loaded, this scrollable board and the workflow selector at line 174 both use `pipelines.workflowTabs` as their accessible name. Assistive-technology users therefore hear “Available project workflows” for both the tab list and the separate board region, obscuring which target contains the draggable columns; use a board-specific localized label here.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Register FullCalendar locales before showing text controls**

For the default Spanish locale—and likewise the supported French, German, and Portuguese locales—no FullCalendar locale bundle is registered anywhere in the UI, so `locale={locale}` falls back to English. Setting `buttonIcons={false}` therefore replaces the language-neutral navigation arrows with visible English labels such as “prev”, “next”, “today”, “month”, “week”, and “day” on this otherwise Spanish page. Register the relevant FullCalendar locales or provide localized `buttonText` values before disabling the icons.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prevent cancellation after the reservation request starts**

When Stripe readiness has completed but `createPaymentIntent` is still pending, the newly enabled Cancel button calls `handleClose`, unmounting this component and invalidating the attempt without aborting or compensating for the API request. If the server completes the request, `SocialEventsHandlers.hs` creates a pending order and increments `EventTicketTierQuantitySold`, while the response is discarded and the buyer never receives the payment form; repeated slow-request cancellations can therefore consume ticket availability. Keep cancellation limited to the pre-request readiness phase, or cancel/release any reservation that completes after closure.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve successful payments after dialog dismissal**

If the buyer presses Escape or clicks the backdrop while `stripe.confirmPayment()` is pending, the dialog remains dismissible because `reservationPending` only covers the earlier intent request; `handleClose` then increments `buyerAttempt`, so this check discards a later successful payment. The page's `onSuccess` callback consequently never invalidates ticket/order queries or displays confirmation, leaving a charged buyer likely to retry. Either prevent dismissal while payment confirmation is pending or continue delivering the successful completion callback.
